intro:
**Force and Translational Dynamics** — 18–23% of the AP Physics 1 exam. Work through it in order. **Take the Concept Check first**, before any lesson: it is calculator-free, not graded, and only shows you your score. After the last lesson, take **the same Concept Check again** to see how far your thinking has moved.

Lessons marked *planned* are not built yet. (Lesson numbers follow the teaching order; the architecture doc's module numbers are renumbered to match under §12.16.)
